subject: general
question: Which country hosted Asia Badminton Championship in Feb 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Philippines.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Rizal Memorial Coliseum** in **Manila, Philippines**, hosted the **2020 Badminton Asia Team Championships** from February 11 to 16, 2020.
 
• This championship was organized by the** Badminton Asia** with **Philippine Badminton Association **as host organizer and sanctioned by the **Badminton World Federation.**
 
• This tournament served as the Asian qualifiers for the **2020 Thomas & Uber Cup** in **Denmark.**
 
• In the men's and women's categories, **Indonesia and Japan** were the reigning champions.
 
• **Champions**:

 
 

 Men's teams
 Indonesia
 
 

 Women's teams
 Japan
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2022 Badminton Asia Team Championships** were held from 15 to 20 February 2022 at the **Setia City Convention Centre in Shah Alam**, **Selangor, Malaysia.**
 
• This championship was organized by **Badminton Asia** with the **Badminton Association of Malaysia** as the host organizer.
 
• The** Badminton World Federation** sanctioned it.
 
• It served as the **Asian qualifier** for the **Thomas & Uber Cup**, which will be held in **Thailand in 2022.**
 
• **Indonesia, the three-time champions**, and **Japan** were the defending champions of the men's and women's category.
